Question B-001-009-004.

Why the correct answer is right: The station owner may choose any qualified amateur radio operator as control operator.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Any person over 21 years of age with a Basic Qualification": Age 21 is outside the control-operator qualification rule.
- sourceIndex 2: "Any person over 21 years of age with Basic and Morse code qualifications": This adds both an age condition and Morse requirement not present in the rule.
- sourceIndex 3: "Any person over 21 years of age": Age alone never makes someone a qualified amateur control operator.
